text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 requires threads to be kept soft and retapped after surface treatment, but no thread feature or dimension exists anywhere on the drawing. This contradiction will confuse manufacturing and inspection because there is nothing to mask or retap; the designer should remove the thread-related instructions from N3 or add the missing thread dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Remove items 3 and 4 from note N3, or add the required thread callouts and dimensions to the drawing."}]}
